title: Trader Diary: The 3‑Minute Chart Stare
content:
👀 1:00 am – I’m glued to the 1‑min BTC chart, heart pounding like a meme coin launch.
🚀 2:00 am – Spot INIT soaring +25.7% and I’m like, “Should I add to my coffee or my position?”
😂 3:00 am – Realize I’ve been watching the chart longer than my last relationship.
lesson: If the chart feels like a Netflix binge, hit pause – leverage isn’t a snack.
question: Who else was up at 2 am watching INIT explode and then questioning life choices? Be honest 👇
